meta.note: Deep-merged over ui/card/data/recipe.json by build.js (arrays replace outright). Everything here is what the kitchen-app PAGE has and the teaser card must not: six steps as {name, text, duration, audio} — richer than the card model's string[] and never handed to render.js (build.js renders the card without ingredients/instructions and hand-authors both bands) — the fuller ingredient list, and the narration file. `narration` and per-step `audio`/`duration` are page-local, not card-model fields; durations are ISO 8601 and drive the step timers.

instructions.name: Boil & salt
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil, then salt it generously — it should taste like the sea.

instructions.name: Crisp the guanciale
instructions.text: Cut the guanciale into short strips and crisp them in a dry pan over medium heat until golden. Pull the pan off the heat.

instructions.name: Make the cream
instructions.text: Whisk the egg yolks with the grated pecorino and plenty of coarsely ground black pepper into a thick paste.

instructions.name: Cook the pasta
instructions.text: Cook the spaghetti until just shy of al dente. Scoop out 250 ml of the starchy cooking water before you drain.

instructions.name: Toss, off the heat
instructions.text: Toss the hot pasta with the guanciale and its fat. Off the heat, stir in the egg mixture, loosening with splashes of pasta water until glossy.

instructions.name: Serve
instructions.text: Serve immediately in warm bowls, with more pecorino and black pepper on top.
